questions.question_text: Ava drinks $\frac{2}{7}$ L in the morning and $\frac{3}{7}$ L later. How much altogether?

options.why: This adds the denominators as well as the numerators.
This finds a difference instead of the total.

questions.question_text: A roll has $\frac{11}{12}$ m left. A piece of $\frac{5}{12}$ m is cut off. How much remains? Give the answer in simplest form.

options.why: This is equivalent but has not been simplified to the expected answer.
This adds the cut piece instead of subtracting it.

questions.question_text: A board is $\frac{8}{15}$ red and $\frac{3}{15}$ blue. How much more is red than blue?

options.why: This finds the combined painted amount, not the difference.
This subtracts numerators but incorrectly combines denominators.

questions.question_text: A track team completes $\frac{2}{9}$, $\frac{3}{9}$ and $\frac{1}{9}$ of a relay. What fraction is complete? Give the answer in simplest form.

options.why: This is equivalent but has not been simplified.
This adds the denominators instead of keeping ninths.

questions.question_text: A hiker travels $\frac{6}{10}$ of a trail, then walks back $\frac{2}{10}$. What net fraction forward is she?

options.why: This adds the backward distance instead of subtracting it.
This subtracts numerators but incorrectly adds denominators.

questions.question_text: A project is $\frac{7}{8}$ complete. Today, $\frac{3}{8}$ was completed. What fraction had been complete before today?

options.why: This adds today’s work to the current total.
This subtracts numerators but incorrectly adds denominators.
